system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The system prompt is assembled in `agent/prompt.py` from modular sections.
system_prompt_style.note: AGENTS.md read from sandbox and injected into system prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The full Linear issue (title, description, comments) or Slack thread history is assembled and passed to the agent, so it starts with rich context rather than discovering everything through tool calls.
env_context_strategy.note: AGENTS.md + source context injected; agent also navigates with built-in file/search/shell tools. Closest value mixed; injected context is not a file tree.

context_compaction.note: Deep Agents may provide summarization but evidence does not show it.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Open SWE uses the OpenAI Responses API by default because OpenAI reasoning models with function tools reject `reasoning_effort` on Chat Completions.

tool_count.note: README comparison table says '~15, curated'; exact default count not determinable.

edit_primitive.note: Built-in Deep Agents tools include file writes and edits; primitive not specified in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The agent will automatically see the tool's name, docstring, and parameter types — the docstring serves as the tool description, so write it clearly.
tool_schema_source.note: MCP via optional Datadog/Corridor hosted MCP servers.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Set `CORRIDOR_API_TOKEN` (or `CORRIDOR_MCP_TOKEN` / `CORRIDOR_TOKEN`) to load Corridor's hosted MCP server for each agent run.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Deterministic middleware hooks run around the agent loop:
loop_primitives.note: Loop is LangGraph/Deep Agents agent loop; event_driven via webhook triggers and mid-run message injection.

planning_granularity.note: File tree shows agent/middleware/plan_mode.py, agent/tools/save_plan.py, agent/dashboard/plan_store.py; mechanism and default not shown.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The main agent can fan out independent subtasks to isolated subagents — each with its own middleware stack and file operations.
multi_agent_topology.note: The task tool is built into Deep Agents and on by default.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Deep Agents framework natively supports spawning child agents via the `task` tool.

human_in_loop.note: README says 'No production access, no confirmation prompts' in the sandbox; local mode mentions human-in-the-loop; workflow_approval.py exists. Users can inject follow-up messages mid-run (steering).

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: If the repo contains an `AGENTS.md` file at the root, it's read from the sandbox and injected into the system prompt.
long_term_memory.note: Skill library inferred from agent/bundled_skills/*/SKILL.md and agent/skills/continual-learning/SKILL.md in the file tree; AGENTS.md is repo-authored rather than agent-written memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Each thread gets a persistent sandbox (reused across follow-up messages)
state_persistence.note: Deterministic thread IDs route follow-ups to the same LangGraph thread; checkpoint read-back not shown directly.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The agent is instructed to run linters, formatters, and tests before committing
self_verification.note: Validation is prompt-driven only and not harness-enforced. A separate reviewer graph exists.

retry_policy.note: agent/middleware/task_retry.py exists; its scope is unknown.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: After-agent hook that posts a Slack reply when the agent hits the model-call limit
termination_condition.note: model_declared: the agent ends by itself after opening the PR.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `max_tokens` is a maximum completion/output token budget, not the model's total context window.
cost_controls.note: Per-call output cap. Gateway spend limits are opt-in. model_fallback middleware exists.

timeouts.note: agent/middleware/model_call_timeout.py and timeout_wrapup.py exist; per_run is not confirmed.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: By default, Open SWE runs each task in a [LangSmith cloud sandbox](https://docs.smith.langchain.com/)
execution_isolation.note: Alternatives are daytona, runloop, e2b, modal, and local (no isolation).

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The repo is cloned in, the agent gets full permissions, and the blast radius of any mistake is fully contained.

network_policy.note: A LangSmith egress proxy injects credentials.

permission_model.evidence_quote: No production access, no confirmation prompts.

tracing.evidence_quote: it adds central spend limits, PII/secrets redaction, and tracing

eval_hooks.note: Reviewer eval only; not a coding benchmark.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Slack Connect channels are refused before a run starts, and channel-verification failures fail closed.
guardrails.note: The quote is an invocation-level gate. action_policies is inferred from agent/middleware/pr_creation_guard.py and workflow_push_guard.py in the file tree. Corridor analyzePlan is optional. Gateway PII redaction is opt-in.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Open-source framework for building your org's internal coding agent.

pinned_version.note: No tag is given in the evidence.
